November 2025

Monthly Tweet Summary

TL;DR

This month centered on Noriko's emotional struggle over a voice acting opportunity and a potential move to Tokyo. Ultimately, she chose to stay with the club, and the members, their bonds deeper than ever, have begun preparing for a newly booked Christmas event in Tokyo this December.

Monthly Highlights

November was a heartwarming month for Ikizulive club as everyone watched over Noriko's major life decision. Her choice to stay in Fukui despite having a ticket to her dreams in Tokyo led to a collective vow from the members to support her no matter what. With Shion's birthday, the debut of a new signature pose, and a confirmed year-end stage performance, the community's energy is heating up for winter.

Noriko's Big Decision: Choosing the Club Over Tokyo

After winning an encouragement award at a Tokyo audition and being offered a spot at UTX Academy, Noriko agonized over the choice. Despite fierce support from Miracle and others to pursue her dream, she decided, 'I want to be with everyone,' and stayed in Fukui. Miracle vowed to help Noriko debut as a voice actor through their own idol activities.
